about_the_game:
LOST: Another Realm is a survival horror game inspired by Indonesian folklore and its mythical creatures with a touch of fantasy.

Set in the mystical Kalash Mountain with terrifying creatures and unexpected futures, don’t ever let your guard down. You never know what might happen next in a realm full of unknowns.

Uncover Family Mysteries

The sudden loss of Arga’s parents leads Arga to darker secrets he has never imagined before. Players must find a way to survive while trying to figure out the secrets that its mountain holds.

Master Survival Mechanics

Take advantage of its environmental elements such as bushes and trees to hide or trick the enemies. But don’t forget to pay attention to your health and stamina and use them wisely as they might run out while you’re in survival mode!

The Supernatural Creatures

Face Indonesian supernatural creatures with certain strategies and the Relics usage in order to survive. Every creature has a different ability where some of them are deadly and might put your life at stake, so learn their abilities carefully.

The Powerful Relics

There will be seven Relics from seven Nations in the game, each with Mystic Stone carved on it that holds special powers. Each Relic possesses a story and different powers, where every piece of them can be used to help the players survive in another realm.

Learn the story, learn the powers, and you might also learn the hidden truths of Arga’s family as well as the mystical Kalash Mountain.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence, blood and gore, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter frightening supernatural creatures and experience dark themes related to survival, trauma, and loss.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: A survival horror game where the strange loss of a plane leads Arga to darker secrets of his family and the mystical Kalash Mountain.
